title: 20% of US residents can now recycle paper cups, FPI says
summary: Paper cup recycling access has nearly quadrupled during the last decade, according to FPI. But more work is needed, including on end markets as some mills that accepted the material have recently left the pool.

title: Maine’s packaging EPR implementation lags
summary: The Maine Department of Environmental Protection still expects producers will owe money this year. But the process of contracting with a stewardship organization has repeatedly been pushed back.

title: When route knowledge walks out the door: The hidden risk in waste collection operations
summary: When experienced drivers or route planners leave, that loss quickly turns into missed pickups, rising costs and service disruptions.

title: Clean Harbors gets FTC approval to acquire Terra Nova Solutions
summary: This would be Clean Harbors’ second major acquisition this year. The company has looked to spend more on M&A this year, expanding its environmental services footprint.

title: Republic Services beats headwinds to deliver growth in Q1
summary: The company grew key financial metrics despite headwinds from commodity prices, fuel costs and extreme weather in the first quarter. Executives said the environmental services business would also strengthen as the year goes on.

title: CAA seeks to standardize responsible end market requirements
summary: CAA seeks public comments on a proposed REM standard meant to be cohesive across packaging EPR states. It ensures materials are handled in an environmentally sound way.

title: Mill strikes deal with Compass Group to enter commercial kitchens
summary: The company has partnered with Google and Amazon as it develops a commercial-sized machine. Mill is planning significant growth for its food waste processors in the commercial space.

title: Could construction sites be the next source for recycled plastic?
summary: Canadian researchers with Light House found that 77% of plastic collected at construction sites was recyclable. It recommends parallel investments in end markets and recycling infrastructure.

title: Clean Harbors raises guidance after record-high Q1 revenue
summary: The company said landfill volumes increased 34% year over year in part due to PFAS-related project work. Other segments also outperformed expectations, prompting Clean Harbors to raise full-year guidance.

title: EPA promotes chemical recycling amid polarizing public comment period
summary: Stakeholders are split on an EPA proposal to remove pyrolysis from an air emissions rule, a move that will have direct implications for the chemical recycling industry.
